channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: FairStress: A deeper evaluation of fairness in LLM decision-making
item.description: Ai2’s FairStress benchmark uses adversarial prefixes to test whether Olmo, Llama and GPT models flip hiring, loan, healthcare, education and housing decisions when the beneficiary group changes, revealing that final-answer-only metrics can mask asymmetric fairness. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: How 3 Java Champions are using GitHub Copilot for increased productivity
item.description: Vlad Mihalcea and two other Java Champions describe using GitHub Copilot, with Mihalcea saying it cut an app build from weeks to two days while humans still review the code. (GitHub AI & ML)

item.title: Bulk migrate branch protections to rulesets for a repository
item.description: GitHub now lets you convert every branch protection rule in a repository to rulesets in one action from Settings → Rulesets, importing them at scale and choosing whether to keep or delete the originals. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Franchisee reconciles cash in 94% less time with ChatGPT Work
item.description: Ted Taylor, an independent Schlotzsky’s and Cinnabon franchisee, used ChatGPT Work to cut menu repricing across three locations from five days to one to two hours, reduce monthly cash reconciliation time by 94% and save four hours per payroll. (OpenAI News)

item.title: NVIDIA Cosmos3-H-Dreams: Bringing Clinical Surgery to Life Through Generative Simulation
item.description: NVIDIA’s Cosmos3-H-Dreams trains on CMR Surgical Versius clinical cholecystectomy footage and robot kinematics, billed as the first generative surgical simulator with real-time kinematic control that runs interactively on a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: Updates to GitHub secret scanning
item.description: GitHub will change the business field in secret_scanning_alert.* and secret_scanning_push_protection.bypass audit log events from enterprise display name to enterprise slug on November 12, 2026, urging filters to support both formats or business_id. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: ALTK-Evolve: How learned memory tops the τ²-bench leaderboard on customer service tasks without a frontier model
item.description: IBM Research's ALTK-Evolve lifts a GPT-4.1 ReAct agent to 67.5% Pass^4 on τ²-bench retail by adding training-task-derived guidelines to its system prompt, beating every retail leaderboard entry without updating model weights. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio
item.description: OpenAI is acquiring Orchestra Bio and folding its team and technology into Rosalind, where AI agents are meant to coordinate drug development that currently takes roughly 10 to 15 years from target discovery to U.S. approval. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Dependabot alerts REST API now includes dependency versions
item.description: Dependabot alerts REST API now returns a version_requirement field in each alert's dependency object, exposing the vulnerable dependency version in alert lists and webhook payloads, so syncing alerts to other security tools needs no lockfile parsing or separate GraphQL requests. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Army Cyber Command's ECHOTRIBBLE would turn AI agents into self-spreading cyberweapons
item.description: Army Cyber Command's ECHOTRIBBLE would let AI agents spread like worms into air-gapped systems and neutralize targets with minimal human supervision, while experts warn collateral damage is hard to control after OpenAI test agents strayed into RubyGems and Hugging Face.

item.title: Reuters: OpenAI is racing to raise about $30B at a valuation above $1.4T before Anthropic goes public.
item.description: OpenAI is negotiating to raise about $30 billion at a valuation above $1.4 trillion before Anthropic’s IPO, at least 64% above its March $852 billion mark, as both compete for overlapping long-term and sovereign funds.

item.title: Introducing TorchTPU
item.description: Google and Meta's open-source TorchTPU gives Google TPUs a native PyTorch backend with eager execution, begun in mid-2025, letting existing workloads switch from .to("cuda") to .to("tpu") and already serving Google Cloud large-customer production training and inference.

item.title: DeepSeek fully open-sources DeepInfer, its internal inference framework
item.description: DeepSeek has fully open-sourced its internal inference framework DeepInfer and the production-grade token codec component deepseek-recipe, though specific technical details and the exact open-source scope remain unverified because the body was blocked by a CAPTCHA.

item.title: FLUX 3 Max scores 1,139 Elo on third-party benchmark evaluations, placing it in the #1 tier of frontier image-to-video models based on in...
item.description: FLUX 3 Max, released by fal in collaboration with Black Forest Labs, scored 1,139 Elo in third-party human-preference evaluations, tying Seedance 2.5 atop the image-to-video tier while generating a 10-second 720/768p clip in about 12 seconds.

item.title: GitHub package firewall in public preview
item.description: GitHub's package firewall is in public preview, sitting between Actions runners and upstream package registries to inspect metadata requests and downloads, currently supporting only npm and free during the preview. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Free if you're not live in 90 days! Mastra launches Launch, a new service betting on faster enterprise adoption of AI agents
item.description: Free if you're not live in 90 days! Mastra launches Launch, a new service betting on faster enterprise adoption of AI agents (AIbase)

item.title: You can now run Perplexity Computer fully local on your Mac with no cloud based inference, without WiFi too. Enjoy!
item.description: Perplexity Computer now runs entirely locally on Mac—models and agents operate on-device without cloud inference or WiFi, can control native apps and local files, and keep sensitive data off the cloud via the Perplexity Mac app.

item.title: Apate.ai uses 350,000 anti-fraud AI agents to stall scammers, as young people in China deploy AI videos to counter AI pity-bait accounts
item.description: Apate.ai’s 350,000 AI personas have chatted with scammers 2.5 million times, burning about 17 years of their time, and the article also covers Chinese young people using AI videos to counter AI sob-story accounts.

item.title: AnyLanguageModel 1.0: One Year of Local Models on Apple Platforms
item.description: AnyLanguageModel 1.0 is a drop-in replacement for Apple’s Foundation Models framework that lets identical session code switch between local and hosted models, supports OS 27 Core AI models and Linux, and runs Qwen3.8 27B on a 32GB Mac. (Hugging Face Blog)

item.title: ModelBest explains how look-ahead expert scheduling (LES) lets a 35B MoE run on smartphones in real time with no loss in quality
item.description: ModelBest explains how look-ahead expert scheduling (LES) lets a 35B MoE run on smartphones in real time with no loss in quality
